name: zmodel_dipool_read_header_from_stream
description: zModel_DiPool::ReadHeaderFromStream reads the serialized DI pool capacity, in-use count, and free-list head from a stream.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zModel DI pool/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x481bc0 validates three 4-byte fread calls, failure lines 0x28b/0x298/0x2a5 through zError::ReportOldNoOp, success return 0, and failure return -1.
The native DI pool read smoke verifies the header fields are read into g_zModel_DiPoolCapacity, g_zModel_DiPoolInUseCount, and g_zModel_DiPoolFreeHeadIndex through zModel_DiPool::ReadFromStream.
